Al Noor Cleaning started with one bay and a rule: **tell people the price before you touch the car**. Fifteen years later we have six bays, and the rule has not changed.

help.body: Talk to a licensed technician, not a call centre. Free advice, no obligation.

items.question: Do you charge for estimates?
items.answer: No. You get a written quote before any work starts, and nothing happens until you approve it. Diagnostic time is one hour, credited back if you go ahead with the repair here.

items.question: Do I need an appointment?
items.answer: Not for oil changes or tire swaps — walk in. Book ahead for anything diagnostic.

items.question: How long does a brake job take?
items.answer: Two to three hours for a standard front or rear axle.

items.question: Is the work guaranteed?
items.answer: Parts and labour are guaranteed for two years on every repair, at any of our partner shops across Ontario.

items.question: Which cars do you work on?
items.answer: Every make, domestic and import, including hybrids. We do not service commercial trucks over one tonne.

items.question: Can I wait while you work?
items.answer: Yes — there is a waiting room with Wi-Fi and coffee. For longer jobs we offer a free ride within Northside.
